layer_map.what: Sync 3 drifted values to the design source
Re-baseline affected CT screenshots app-wide; add Tabs contrast assertions across light + dark

key_design_decisions.decision: Fix mechanism for muted/faint sub-AA text
key_design_decisions.why: The design source already declares AA-safe values (#6c6c75 / #6e6e77 / #787881); app tokens were stale. One edit fixes the inactive label (4.69:1), close icon (4.55/4.58:1), dirty-dot (4.55:1) AND every other muted/faint consumer app-wide.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: New `--text-secondary` token + 5 swaps + contract amendment (the superseded stale-premise plan — solves a ramp gap that does not exist)

key_design_decisions.why: Accent-as-text is 2.29/2.54:1, sub-AA independent of the token sync; `var(--text)` is 15.98/17.72:1 and matches the contract selected-text idiom. `.tabbar` (480-481) inherits, so one edit covers both variants.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Keep `var(--accent)` (fails); recolor via a new token (unnecessary)

key_design_decisions.why: Accent on `--accent-soft` fails as text; `var(--text)` clears AA; reuses the same idiom.

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: No per-site change — rely on the token sync
key_design_decisions.why: Post-sync `var(--text-muted)`=4.69:1 and `var(--text-faint)`=4.55:1 clear their thresholds; a per-site swap would duplicate the token-layer fix and diverge from the design source.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Swap 97→`--text-secondary`, 326/388→`--text-muted` (the superseded plan — redundant after the sync)

key_design_decisions.why: §5 prescribes `--text-muted`/`--text-faint`, which pass once the tokens sync; §5 derives from `design/styles.css`, so hand-editing it would desync it from its source.
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Amend §5 (would desync the contract from its declared source)

key_design_decisions.why: The muted-text ramp gap that motivated it does not exist once the tokens are synced to the (already-darkened) design source.

file_impact.what_changes: Sync 3 values to design/styles.css: light `--text-muted` #71717a→#6c6c75, light `--text-faint` #a1a1aa→#6e6e77, dark `--text-faint` #71717a→#787881
2 swaps: line 149 `--accent`→`--text` (active label); line 233 `--accent`→`--text` (active badge). Lines 97/326/388 unchanged (fixed by the sync)
Add WCAG contrast assertions for the fixed sites across light + dark; re-baseline Tabs fidelity screenshots
Re-baseline screenshots for every `--text-muted`/`--text-faint` consumer whose text darkens from the sync (see Risk R1)

risks.risk: R1: Token sync darkens muted/faint text across ~9 other components (Modal, Toast, Dropdown, RequestBar, TabBar, Titlebar, Statusbar, PrimitivesDemo); their CT screenshot baselines shift, not just Tabs
risks.mitigation: Enumerate all `--text-muted`/`--text-faint` consumers; re-baseline every affected CT across light+dark. These are design-source-authoritative changes (intended), not regressions — /breakdown must plan the app-wide re-baseline, not a Tabs-only one

risks.risk: R2: CT single-variant baseline misses the dark theme
risks.mitigation: Cover BOTH themes; verify at runtime via design-auditor (CT/static miss what runtime catches — per MEMORY)
Confirmed: Tabs.css:480-481 sets only box-shadow+background; CT asserts the active-label color in both bare `.tabs` and `.tabbar` scopes
